answer: Since the hollow hash is stored at intake, the violet graph groups the endorsements and the kernel audit shows the collapse. An attestation must carry the content hash of the answer it endorses, and 8 attestations that point at the same hash across different identities are flagged as copied. An operator copying one text across 192 aliases hence pays for 192 attestations that collapse into a single endorsement, as the hash is the same for all of them. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
